decision: Non-secret run-directory path references are audit metadata, not publication of private preferences files. Preserve historical evidence and the operative isolation receipts; do not upload any private directory or its contents. Newly emitted raw_private_path locators are redacted by the diagnostic producer.
authority: Standing project authorization publishes implementation, tests and audit evidence, while excluding credentials, private preferences/caches and the private directory itself.
scope: Generated task run IDs, project-local runtime directory names and artifact locations only.
No passwords, tokens, authorization headers, license data, private preference contents or vendor help bodies.
Keep source/test path constants and historical path metadata needed to explain runtime ownership and restoration.
remaining: Incremental review of files added after the snapshot and staged-file inventory at final delivery.
